name: 07866 · Rockaway, NJ
findings: ZIP 07866 (Rockaway) has 94 nonprofit organizations. 50 of them (53%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 42 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (28% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 07866 (Rockaway) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 07866 (Rockaway) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.7 times the typical level).
